archetypes.name: wrapper-parity
archetypes.rationale: The new Python verbs mirror shell wrapper contracts across telemetry, state seeding, and ship dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new implement_dispatch.py wrapper verbs against the existing shell wrappers. Focus on argv validation, env rehydration, stdout KV compatibility, and side effects such as seed files and phantom warnings. Flag any behavior that would change active /implement routing if consumers switch from shell to Python. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: safety-net-ledger
archetypes.rationale: The Step 18 execution-issues safety net must append without erasing the source log.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review execution_issues.flush_execution_issues_safety_net and the Step 18 integration. Confirm the safety net is append-only, idempotent against existing batch records, best effort on terminal cleanup, and does not weaken the Step 7a truncating checkpoint semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
